decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed sign, due to its compatible scale, appearance and position, would be in keeping with the character and appearance of the school and the street scene, would not harm neighbours' living conditions and would not result in conditions prejudicial to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area. The proposal therefore complies with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.1.4 (Advertisements) and ENV-B.1.8 (Access and facilities for people with disabilities) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
Condition : 2 - Any structure or hoarding erected or used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a safe condition.

Condition : 3 - No advertisment shall be sited or displayed so as to obscure, or hinder, the ready interpretation of any road sign, railway sign or aid to navigation by water or air so as to otherwise render hazardous the use of any highway, railway, waterway ( including any coastal waters) or aerodrome (civil or military).
description: Erection of a free standing non-illuminated sign.
